lines: You're not usually this eager, Clau.
Good to meet you.
I'm with Castor Co., I...
Good to meet you.
I'm with WWWWWWWWWWWWWWWWWWWW, I...
Vels was in the wrong. Greed
blinded him and he betrayed you.
I can't forgive him for it!
Thank you! Please train us, too.
We're ready.
We need you aboard.
With you at our side, I think
we could make history!
I've left the sea behind.
That's enough for today. Please go.
I have something to teach you
before I head back to sea.
Are you up for special training?
You've got guts.
Don't quit halfway through.
